title: 8BR Estate | Indoor Basketball Court, Pool & Views
description: Escape to a rare 6,900-square-foot North Scottsdale estate where panoramic mountain views meet one-of-a-kind recreation. Designed for families and golf groups of up to 22, the home offers 8 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms, 5 king beds, a detached casita, private indoor basketball court, oversized putting green, heated pool, hot tub, fire pit and pool table. Pool heat and fire pit use are included. Minutes from Troon, Grayhawk, TPC Scottsdale and Kierland. Come for the views. Stay for the experience.
amenities: 75 inch HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Chromecast, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix, premium cable
Exercise equipment: free weights, stationary bike, yoga mat
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated
